dossier.summary: Pennant sells HR, scheduling and tip payout software to restaurants with hourly staff.

findings.quote: People-first HR for the modern workforce.
findings.cost: A restaurant owner with 40 hourly staff can't tell this handles shifts and tip payouts. It sounds like software for an office.

findings.quote: Hire, onboard, schedule and pay your team, all in one place.
findings.cost: The clearest line on the page, but it never says restaurants, so it reads like every other HR tool.
Owners run the floor at night. A button that needs a call during the day gets put off for weeks.
Which businesses? If they are restaurants, say so. That is the whole pitch.

rewrites.before: People-first HR for the modern workforce.
rewrites.after: HR, scheduling and tip payouts for restaurants with hourly teams.
rewrites.why: A restaurant owner sees their own week in the first line.

rewrites.before: Hire, onboard, schedule and pay your team, all in one place.
rewrites.after: Hire, schedule and pay your restaurant staff, tips included.
rewrites.why: Same promise, but now it names who it is for and the thing other tools miss.
Owners can check the price after close, without waiting for a call.
